text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of the Japanese Derby, Duramente 
shocked everyone by announcing her entry 
into the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. She 
caused quite a stir, declaring her 
ambition to be the world's strongest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by that, Satono Crown, Kitasan 
Black, and their other generational rivals 
threw themselves enthusiastically into 
preparing for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst all this, Cheval Grand's feelings 
for the "Japanese Derby" began to 
overflow. A challenge on the grand stage 
where her idol once stood—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While her generation rivals each harbor 
their own feelings, Cheval Grand also 
takes on the challenge for the 
generation's highest crown with burning 
passion.
